import json

    raw = f.read()

outer = json.loads(raw)

data = json.loads(result_str)
experiments = data["data"]["experiments"]

# Extract all repo-level experiments
repo_keys = sorted([k for k in experiments.keys() if "repo-level" in k])

# First, print repo-level-cls-v5 verbatim
print("=" * 80)
print("VERBATIM: repo-level-cls-v5")
print("=" * 80)
if "repo-level-cls-v5" in experiments:
    print(json.dumps(experiments["repo-level-cls-v5"], indent=2))
else:
    print("NOT FOUND")

print("\n\n")

# Now extract structured info for all repo-level experiments
print("=" * 80)
print("ALL REPO-LEVEL EXPERIMENTS")
print("=" * 80)

for eid in repo_keys:
    exp = experiments[eid]
    print(f"\n{'─' * 70}")
    print(f"exp_id: {eid}")
    print(f"  status:          {exp.get('status', 'N/A')}")
    print(f"  conclusion:      {exp.get('conclusion', 'N/A')}")
    
    # model_name from spec
    spec = exp.get('spec', {}) or {}
    print(f"  model_name:      {spec.get('model_name', spec.get('model', 'N/A'))}")
    
    # type
    exp_type = exp.get('type', 'N/A')
    if exp_type == 'N/A':
        # infer from exp_id
        if '-cls' in eid:
            exp_type = 'cls (inferred)'
        elif '-cwm' in eid:
            exp_type = 'cwm (inferred)'
    print(f"  type:            {exp_type}")
    
    # seed
    seed = exp.get('seed', spec.get('seed', 'N/A'))
    print(f"  seed:            {seed}")
    
    # server
    print(f"  server:          {exp.get('server', 'N/A')}")
    
    # metrics
    metrics = exp.get('metrics', exp.get('results', {})) or {}
    if metrics:
        print(f"  metrics:")
        for mk, mv in metrics.items():
            print(f"    {mk}: {mv}")
    else:
        print(f"  metrics:         (none)")
    
    # notes/remarks
    notes = exp.get('notes', exp.get('remarks', exp.get('note', 'N/A')))
    print(f"  notes:           {notes}")
    
    # checkpoint_path
    cp = exp.get('checkpoint_path', exp.get('checkpoint', 'N/A'))
    if cp == 'N/A':
        cp = spec.get('checkpoint_path', spec.get('checkpoint', 'N/A'))
    print(f"  checkpoint_path: {cp}")
    
    # updated_at
    print(f"  updated_at:      {exp.get('updated_at', 'N/A')}")
